label: Registered result
hypothesis: A customer-level promo lifts order value per customer-day
estimand: short-run effect of on against off under alternation, per unit-day

prediction.statement: The experiment agrees with the World Model's slope (fitted from history): the prior lies inside the interval the experiment earned for the coefficient.

assumptions: Carryover longer than the washout leaks an on period's effect into the next off period, which biases the estimate toward zero.

Pull-forward — a customer who buys during an on period instead of later depletes the next off period — biases the estimate away from zero. The estimate is the short-run effect of on against off under alternation, not of leaving the lever on.

treated_total.basis: Exact arithmetic on the on days: mean × units × days.

promise.message: The estimate is above the $8.10/unit-day the design promised it could read.

checks.pre_trend_note: A switchback has no control arm, so there is no parallel-trends check; pairing is its substitute.

proposals.message: 1 assignment was drawn before the registered one.
